verdict.rationale: Jan is a local AI chat app, so on-device speech dictation is a fair question to ask of it, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions speech input, dictation, or a speech-to-text model. The evidence covers only running local LLMs, cloud model connections, the local API server, assistants, and MCP integration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
